assay: bulk RNA-seq (SMARTer) of FACS-sorted Nes-GFP+ precursor cells
experiments_sequenced: Experiment 1: Nes-GFP+ cells from DG vs SVZ of the same standard-housed animals (S2.2.p1, S4.4.10.1.p1) -> GSE123961
Experiment 2: DG Nes-GFP+ cells sorted by ROS class (hi/mid/loROS) from standard-housed animals (S2.3.p1, S4.4.10.1.p1) -> other SubSeries
primary_estimand: For GSE123961: region-specific transcription (DG vs SVZ) in Nes-GFP+ precursors of standard-housed mice. No exercise estimand is sequenced; running-wheel effects (S2.1, S2.6) are measured only by BrdU/IdU counts, flow-cytometric ROS and western blot.
planned_contrasts: DG vs SVZ 'enriched'/'signature' transcripts (S4.4.11.p1; Table S1) - not an exercise contrast
housing: all sequenced animals standard housed (S2.2.p1, S4.4.10.1.p1; GEO growth_protocol 'Standard housing')
sample_exclusion: one low-depth sample per experiment removed (S4.4.11.p1)
paper_method: edgeR CPM filter (>=1 CPM in 75% of one group) then limma lmFit/topTags (S4.4.11.p1)
paper_results: Table S1 (DG/SVZ enriched transcripts); count not stated in text
